target_customer: Individuals in Sao Paulo selling or buying used cars who want a managed service rather than a classifieds listing
problem: Selling a used car privately in Brazil means photos, ads, strangers, test drives, paperwork and payment risk; dealers pay low prices and hold inventory.
business_model: Managed peer-to-peer marketplace with a fee per completed sale, no inventory

founders.name: Diego Fischer
founders.background_notes: From the YC company page, which lists him under Former Founders.

exit.reason: Not public. PitchBook lists Out of Business and YC lists Inactive; no announcement found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace software is standard; the hard part was operations: photographers, insured test drives, paperwork and payments.

defensibility.rationale: Concierge operations had no network effect early on and could be copied by listing portals or buy-and-resell players.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent bought it. Kavak entered Brazil in 2021 with an inventory model.

market_need_then: A Brazilian report says about half of used car transactions in Brazil are made by individuals through portals such as Webmotors, OLX and Mercado Libre, a fragmented market with friction in private sales.

branding.domain_note: Search results show gocarupi and carupi.com listings; acquisition history not found.

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search returned no press on the brand, name origin or logo; only database profiles.

outcome_analysis: Carupi joined YC in Winter 2020, took the 150 thousand dollar YC investment and per databases about 2 million dollars of seed in September 2020, and grew to a reported team of 50. YC lists it Inactive and PitchBook lists it Out of Business, but no source explains why, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty.
notes: The company has no website listed in the directory, so there was no site to fetch; it is treated as dead or unknown. Seed of 2M rests on CB Insights and PitchBook (database, no press release found); FundedIQ shows a single 200K round in March 2020, conflicting. Founding year conflicts (2017 to 2019 across databases) so left null. Competitor list left empty: searches found only undated pages or 2021 and later entrants (Kavak Brazil July 2021, InstaCarro 2021). Brazilian article on the founder (fusoesaquisicoes) returned 403. Mentioned CTO Nayron Barreto appears only on CB Insights, not recorded as co-founder.
